title: Les centres de santé communautaire
bookshelves: Category: Economics, Finance, Business and Management
summary: This book invites readers to consider health beyond the dichotomy between public institutions on the one hand and private, for-profit companies on the other. Drawing on contributions from scholars across three continents, the book introduces us to organizations that take a radically different approach to healthcare than the mainstream: multidisciplinary teams, interdisciplinarity, consideration of the social determinants of health, citizen involvement in organizational governance, and a focus on marginalized populations. Case studies drawn from North American, European, and African contexts provide a better understanding of how community clinics operate and what makes them unique.
